audit.whatIsWrong: diff says HARD but the final rating line says 'Even matchup'.
audit.why: 46.66% over 928 games is a losing lane, and the corrected chart gives Illaoi four of seven rows — HARD is the honest label, so the rating line was the string out of step.
audit.corrected: report[14].t brought in line with diff; diffRating left at 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every chart row disagreed with the packet, and rows 2-5 disagreed with this entry's own whys.
audit.why: whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] all describe Illaoi taking over once her field is planted, while the chart said Olaf or Skill. The packet chart (Olaf/Skill/Illaoi/Illaoi/Olaf/Illaoi/Skill) matches the prose row for row.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as one atomic group in both layers with ratings 6/5/4/4/6/4/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings say Ragnarok 'cleanses' Test of Spirit's pull and slow.
audit.why: Ragnarok is passive resists plus immunity to disables while he keeps attacking, on 100/90/80s. It cleanses nothing, and Riot's text does not settle whether the slow counts — so the safe, true statement is that the immunity holds only while you are swinging.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as disable immunity held by continuing to attack, with the 100s cost stated in spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings give Olaf's W sustain or omnivamp.
audit.why: Tough It Out is attack speed plus a shield. Against Illaoi the difference matters more than usual: her tentacles heal her off every champion hit, so the fight is her sustain against YOUR PASSIVE, which grows as your health drops — not against a W that never healed.
audit.corrected: Shield and lifesteal separated across whys[1], whys[2], spikes[3], tradeGood, dosFull[1].d and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson is never mentioned anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: It is a 4-second leap onto her target that also makes nearby tentacles swing — it is why disengaging a fight inside her field does not work, and it is the shortest cooldown in her kit by a distance.
audit.corrected: Named in mid with its 4s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither grounding flag in this matchup is used.
audit.why: The kit files tag Undertow AND Leap of Faith with grounding, but neither Riot description mentions it. Per the trust-the-description rule both are treated as tooltip-parse misfires — if Leap of Faith really grounds, it would mean you cannot walk out of her ultimate, which changes the level-6 line completely.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim written; flagged for a human check.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Illaoi carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 6/10, Illaoi carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Identify how Illaoi contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Undertow's slow into an auto wins first contact — with no tentacles planted yet, Illaoi has nothing to answer with.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Respect Illaoi's Test of Spirit completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Undertow's slow and Tough It Out's shield win first contact. Once tentacles are planted, trade only on Test of Spirit's 16s — bank the small lead, don't prove a point.

edits.before: Land the axe slow on Illaoi, walk the pickup for the reset, reave the true damage, and W-sustain whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Undertow her away from the tentacles, walk the pickup to reset its 9s, then Reckless Swing from behind the shield.

edits.before: Land the axe slow on Illaoi, walk the pickup for the reset, reave the true damage, and W-sustain whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Undertow her away from the tentacles, walk the pickup to reset its 9s, then Reckless Swing from behind the shield.

edits.before: Once her E is up the trade is even-ish — she can pull your spirit but you still have Q-slow pressure and W sustain.
edits.after: Once Test of Spirit is up the trade evens — she rips your spirit, but Undertow's slow and your shield still hold.

edits.before: Her tentacle stacks plus slam-heal out-sustain your W-omnivamp and punish every E (Reckless Swing) you throw.
edits.after: Her tentacle stacks and the healing off them out-last your lifesteal, and punish every Reckless Swing you throw.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses her E pull/slow and makes you CC-immune in her field, so this is your all-in and dive window.
edits.after: Ragnarok keeps you disable-immune while you keep swinging in her field — this is your all-in and dive window.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses her E pull/slow and the tentacle-field chaos, letting you all-in or dive her off her field.
edits.after: Ragnarok holds off her CC while you keep attacking — 100s, so spend it to all-in or dive her off her field.

edits.before: Her tentacle stacks plus sustain reclaim lane — her field out-heals your W-omnivamp in any extended brawl.
edits.after: Her tentacle stacks plus sustain reclaim lane — her field out-heals your lifesteal in any extended brawl.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 belong to her: each tentacle stack means her slam-heal out-sustains your W-omnivamp, and your E (Reckless Swing) costs you health she immediately punishes with a full field. Don't burn E into her here — bait nothing, just farm and respect the spirit pull. Level 6 is your one reclaim window: Ragnarok cleanses her E slow and pull and makes you immune to the tentacle-field CC, so that is when you all-in or tower-dive her — she is immobile and helpless the instant you stick to her off her tentacles.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 belong to her: every tentacle heals her when it connects, so her field out-lasts your lifesteal, and Reckless Swing costs you health she punishes instantly. Don't burn it here — farm and respect Test of Spirit's 16s. Remember Harsh Lesson leaps her back onto you every 4 seconds, so there is no walking a fight off inside her field. Level 6 is your one reclaim window: Ragnarok keeps you disable-immune as long as you keep attacking, so that is when you all-in or tower-dive her — off her tentacles she is immobile.

notes: Chart conflict to flag: the mirror (illaoi__olaf) reports rows 4 and 6 moved to Illaoi, but the packet chart has them as Olaf and Skill, and this entry's whys[4] ('this is your all-in and dive window') and whys[6] ('a knife-edge') say the same as the packet. I followed the packet and the prose. Everything else about the chart matches the mirror. Also flagged: the kit file tags Illaoi's Leap of Faith with grounding while Riot's description says only damage plus a tentacle spawn — if that flag is real, the level-6 dive advice needs revisiting, because walking out of her ultimate would not be possible.
